verdict.rationale: Gumroad's llms.txt documents OAuth + MCP access that lets an agent list sales and check payouts for a connected creator, and the public REST API covers sales. There is no evidence of balance-transaction data or of linking a payout or bank deposit to the charges it contains, so the agent would have to infer the reconciliation itself. Missing for 10: balance-transaction endpoint, payout-to-charge linkage per deposit, documented payout fields in the REST API, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
